analysis_note: Torah #87 has exactly one edge in the dataset (id: 297, type: eitza, nodes: יִרְאַת הָעֹנֶשׁ → אֱמוּנָה). There are zero bechina edges for reference===87 in torahData.js. The one dataset edge is correctly classified as eitza: through fear of punishment one comes to greater faith — this is a causal/sequential relationship (one thing leads to another), not a shared-nature equivalence. The teaching's conceptual equalities (יִרְאַת הָעֹנֶשׁ = צֶדֶק; יִרְאַת הָרוֹמְמוּת = אֱמוּנָה; יַעֲקֹב = יִרְאָה; אַבְרָהָם = דְּבֵקוּת) are present in the source text using the bechina markers נִקְרָא and הוּא but are not yet captured as bechina edges in the dataset. Package formation from existing dataset edges is therefore not possible. See torah_87_additions.json for the gap analysis documenting the missing bechina edges.
